acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Briefly, lysates were thawed at room temperature, treated with 5 mM TCEP and 5 mM CAA (both Sigma Aldrich) for reduction and alkylation, and sonicated on ice for 45 s at 70% amplitude.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Briefly, lysates were thawed at room temperature, treated with 5 mM TCEP and 5 mM CAA (both Sigma Aldrich) for reduction and alkylation, and sonicated on ice for 45 s at 70% amplitude.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested with Lys-C endopeptidase (1:400 w/w; Wako Chemicals) for 3 hr, diluted to 1.5 M guanidine-HCl with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate, and incubated overnight with modified sequencing-grade Trypsin (1:400 w/w; Sigma Aldrich).

Proteins were digested with Lys-C endopeptidase (1:400 w/w; Wako Chemicals) for 3 hr, diluted to 1.5 M guanidine-HCl with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate, and incubated overnight with modified sequencing-grade Trypsin (1:400 w/w; Sigma Aldrich).

collision_energy.evidence: Precursor isolation was performed at a width of 1.3 m/z, normalized AGC target of “400”, and fragmentation using electron transfer disassociation with supplemental higher-collisional disassociation with a normalized collision energy of 20.

enrichment_method.evidence: Peptides were incubated with GST-tagged Af1521 macrodomain beads at 100 µL dry beads per 10 mg sample and incubated in a head-over-tail mixer at 4 °C for 3 hr.

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptides were desalted and fractionated on stage tips at high pH and eluted in 2 fractions with 10% or 15% acetonitrile in 50 mM ammonium hydroxide.

ionization_type.evidence: Electrospray ionization was achieved using a NanoSpray Flex NG ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific; spray voltage 2 kV, capillary temperature  275 °C, radio frequency level 40%).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Label-free quantification (LFQ) by fast LFQ was enabled (Cox et al., 2014) and normalization type set to none.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: MS/MS spectra were measured in the Orbitrap, with a maximum precursor injection time of 1000 ms and at 60,000 scan resolution.
